verses.he: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽלְלוּ־אֵ֥ל בְּקָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בִּרְקִ֥יעַ עֻזּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He is the glory of all His saints.
Praise Him for His mighty acts; Praise Him according to His abundant greatness.

verses.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְּתֵ֣קַע שׁוֹפָ֑ר הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּנֵ֣בֶל וְכִנּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Praise Him with the blast of the horn; Praise Him with the psaltery and harp.

verses.he: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ בְתֹ֣ף וּמָח֑וֹל הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בְּמִנִּ֥ים וְעוּגָֽב׃
verses.en: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; Praise Him with stringed instruments and the pipe.
Praise Him with the loud-sounding cymbals; Praise Him with the clanging cymbals.
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Hallelujah.
